headline: BetterBags Next's vendor now takes turns with TradeSkillMaster's vendor window instead of opening together.

entries.title: BetterBags Next's vendor and TradeSkillMaster take turns
entries.details: With TradeSkillMaster loaded, BetterBags Next's vendor and TSM's window no longer open together. A new TradeSkillMaster header button switches to TSM and returns docked items to your backpack, TSM's WoW UI button brings the vendor back, and panes like the Character pane stay aligned.
